'''March 2001 St. Cloud tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in St. Cloud, Minnesota on 24 March 2001. It is known from Peter Jacobson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1947">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-24-rochester-mn-directors-report-3-24-01d1947/ rochester-mn-directors-report-3-24-01], DeckTech (Peter "jeeps" Jacobson, 24 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-24-rochester-mn-directors-report-3-24-01d1947/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 24 March 2001
* '''Site:''' St. Cloud, Minnesota; Granite City Comics, St. Cloud, Minnesota<ref name="tr-d1969" />
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
